response.original_title: Glimpse of Subject Unknown: Corrupted Footage of Victim-98
response.overview: An unexplained encounter marks the beginning of a year that Victim 98 will never fully understand. What initially appears to be an ordinary incident gradually becomes an inescapable nightmare as an unknown presence begins appearing in his everyday life. It neither speaks nor attacks. It simply watches, remaining at a distance while his attempts to understand its existence lead him deeper into confusion, isolation, and psychological deterioration. As the months pass, Victim 98 struggles to distinguish between what he can comprehend and what lies beyond human understanding. Unable to communicate his experiences or escape the presence that follows him, he slowly loses his sense of normality, leaving him trapped in a reality that nobody else can recognise
